releaseNotes:
**Ticket-type filter detection fix**

• Fixed Ticket type groups could not be verified when the native menu contains repeated names, such as Essential Companion under both Accompanying Seat and Companion Card. Each option is now kept separate using its group, subgroup and current label/control association.

• Standard only can now check GA Deck Standing and Lawn General Admission in the supplied menu while leaving both companion options, VIP and resale unchecked. Mastercard Preferred stays excluded unless special offers are enabled. Changing event-generated checkbox IDs does not break the matching.

• Added recognition of the actual circled-star VIP icon for Any tickets. Standard only still excludes the separate VIP group. Price limits, quantities and other exclusions are unchanged; information buttons are not opened.

Tested with the supplied full menu HTML and mocked control updates. Duplicate options within the same subgroup or broken label associations still stop safely. Reload Clickerist and refresh Ticketmaster before starting again. No live reservations were made.
